title: Question-Isolation Protocol at RESEARCH Entry
summary: `/rdd-research` gains a five-step research-entry sequence: the user articulates the research question(s) in the research log before any artifact-corpus read; the agent composes a constraint-removal prompt ("what if [the most consequential existing artifact] were not available?") and the user answers; the research-methods-reviewer dispatch (ADR-060) evaluates the combined question set against four criteria (need-vs-artifact framing, embedded conclusions, prior-art treatment, incongruity surfacing); the user revises or accepts flagged issues with rationale; only then does the research loop begin reading the corpus. Per ADR-067's decision procedure the protocol is classified as first-line structural (Skill-Structure Layer) with a cognitive component, not pure Tier 2.
workflow_point: /rdd-research skill entry, before the artifact corpus is consulted
mechanism: five-step question-isolation sequence: articulate question, constraint-removal prompt, research-methods-reviewer dispatch, revise, then research loop begins

links.note: adds an explicit constraint-removal form to the Inversion Principle's (ADR-055) Question Toolkit, as the primary form for the research-entry moment
classified as first-line structural (Skill-Structure Layer) with a cognitive component, using ADR-058's structural-vs-cognitive tiering, rather than pure Tier 2 (conversational)
extends the research-methods-reviewer dispatch (ADR-060) with question-set review criteria (framing, embedded conclusions, prior-art treatment, incongruity surfacing) evaluated at research entry
applies ADR-067's four-step decision procedure to classify the five-step research-entry sequence as first-line structural (Skill-Structure Layer) with a cognitive component
the honest classification of the protocol's structural-vs-cognitive components, and the acknowledgment that pre-semantic priming is not addressed, follow ADR-069's scope-of-claim discipline

essay 015 grouped this protocol with ADR-077's applicability check under "second-line cognitive"; reconsidered at DECIDE — ADR-077 fires conversationally with no per-step structural anchor (Tier 2), while this protocol step-anchors a five-step sequence and so qualifies as first-line structural with a cognitive component
